|game_text='''Agendas''': order. May be targeted by [[Might Of The Republic]]. Your characters with politics (except Wedge and senators) are deploy -1 and gain [Republic] here. During your turn, may use 1 Force to ▲ a card with 'Valorum', 'governor' or 'political' in lore.
|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E1 of [[Supreme Chancellor Valorum (V)]] (version 2 of 4). This version has no document image of its own, so the image here is a CardMaker recreation of this text ([[:File:VB8-03-Supreme_Chancellor_Valorum-PC-E1-cardmaker.png]]). Versions in date order: [[Supreme Chancellor Valorum (V)]] (original, release sheet of 11 May 2012); '''this page''' (PC-E1, PC website card list, by 21 July 2012); [[Supreme Chancellor Valorum (V) (Errata 2)]] (PC-E2, Master List of 27 April 2013, the same words as the original); [[Supreme Chancellor Valorum (V) (Errata 3)]] (PC-E3, Players Committee card image, uploaded 7 May 2013, the same words as the original, the current text).
* '''Original''' ([[Supreme Chancellor Valorum (V)]]): text as given in the Virtual Block 8.1 release sheet (official text as of 11 May 2012)<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock8_1">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock8_1.pdf#page=5 Virtual Block 8.1 release sheet] ("Official text as of 11 May 2012"; the surviving copy was re-made 18 July 2012), page 5, slip 30 (position on the sheet; the slip prints no number). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261027095418/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock8_1.pdf#page=5 Internet Archive]</ref>: “Agenda: order. May be targeted by Might Of The Republic. Your characters with politics (except Wedge and senators) are deploy -1 (and gain [Republic]) here. During your turn, may use 1 Force to ▲ a card with "governor," "political," or "Valorum" in lore.” The Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB8-L-supremechancellorvalorum-pre.gif]]) and the release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB8-03-Supreme_Chancellor_Valorum.png]]) print it. The Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013, Light Side p. 15) prints this text again; under the ruling of 11 November 2026 (every publication is a version), that copy is its own version, PC-E2 ([[Supreme Chancellor Valorum (V) (Errata 2)]]); the current text is the PC card image uploaded on 7 May 2013 ([[Supreme Chancellor Valorum (V) (Errata 3)]], the same words).<ref name="ml-ls">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf#page=15, page 15. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf#page=15 Internet Archive]</ref> The release-sheet slip prints no slip number.
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): The PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and in every capture to 11 January 2013) changed “Agenda:” to “Agendas:”, dropped the parentheses (“deploy -1 and gain [Republic] here”) and moved “Valorum” first (“a card with 'Valorum', 'governor' or 'political' in lore”)<ref name="cl-1281_30-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock8Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064747/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock8Type.html 2012-07-21] (Internet Archive); the same text in the captures of 12 December 2012 and 11 January 2013</ref>: “Agendas: order. May be targeted by Might Of The Republic. Your characters with politics (except Wedge and senators) are deploy -1 and gain [Republic] here. During your turn, may use 1 Force to ▲ a card with 'Valorum', 'governor' or 'political' in lore.” (The capture of 21 July 2012 prints the ▲ as “/\”; the captures from 12 December 2012 write it out as “take into hand … from Reserve Deck; reshuffle”, which is notation only.) No published card image shows this text; the image of that page is a CardMaker recreation ([[:File:VB8-03-Supreme_Chancellor_Valorum-PC-E1-cardmaker.png]]). The card list was generated from the Players Committee's Holotable card data (research R7, 11 November 2026), so this wording is a transcription the PC published, not a separately announced errata; it is listed because it was published.
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Supreme Chancellor Valorum (V) (Errata 2)]]): the Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013; Light Side, p. 15)<ref name="ml-ls" /> prints the original release-sheet text ([[Supreme Chancellor Valorum (V)]]) again, word for word: “Agenda: order. May be targeted by Might Of The Republic. Your characters with politics (except Wedge and senators) are deploy -1 (and gain [Republic]) here. During your turn, may use 1 Force to ▲ a card with "governor," "political," or "Valorum" in lore.” It is listed as a version because it was published (ruling of 11 November 2026: every publication is a version, even a word-for-word repeat of an earlier text); the PC card image uploaded later ([[Supreme Chancellor Valorum (V) (Errata 3)]]) is the current text. Its image is the Master List slip ([[:File:VL-history-1281-30-front-master.png]]). The Master List slip prints no slip number, like the release-sheet slip and the PC card image.
* '''PC-E3''' ([[Supreme Chancellor Valorum (V) (Errata 3)]]): the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB8-L-supremechancellorvalorum-pre.gif]]) prints the original release-sheet text ([[Supreme Chancellor Valorum (V)]]) again, word for word: “Agenda: order. May be targeted by Might Of The Republic. Your characters with politics (except Wedge and senators) are deploy -1 (and gain [Republic]) here. During your turn, may use 1 Force to ▲ a card with "governor," "political," or "Valorum" in lore.” The image is dated only by its upload to the Players Committee's server: the Apache listing of the Virtual8-Light card-image folder gives every file there the same time, 7 May 2013, 13:52<ref name="pcdir-Virtual8-Light">Players Committee server, [https://web.archive.org/web/20190818034752/https://starwarsccg.org/cardlists/images/starwars/Virtual8-Light/large/?C=M;O=A directory listing of cardlists/images/starwars/Virtual8-Light/large/] sorted by date, as captured 18 August 2019 (Internet Archive)</ref>. That is a bulk upload date, so the image may have been made earlier; it is placed at that date (ruling of 11 November 2026: what was uploaded last counts as the last version). It is listed as a version because it was published (ruling of 11 November 2026: every publication is a version, even a word-for-word repeat). Uploaded after the Master List, it is the latest version and so the current text. The PC card image prints no slip number, like the release-sheet slip.
